request.style: English, male lead vocal with gritty edge, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, piano, organ, intense and reflective mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Philip found Nathanael in the light
Told him of Jesus from Nazareth
We found the one Moses wrote about
In the law and the prophets

[Pre-Chorus]
Can anything good come from there
Nathanael asked with a frown
Come and see said Philip
Then the journey began

[Chorus]
See here is a true Israelite
In whom there is no deceit
No deceit in his heart
A true Israelite

[Verse]
I saw you under the fig tree
Before Philip called you
Nathanael asked how he knew
Jesus spoke the truth

[Chorus]
See here is a true Israelite
In whom there is no deceit
No deceit in his heart
A true Israelite

[Bridge]
Rabbi you are the Son of God
King of Israel is your name
The fig tree witness remains
Faith begins in the light

[Outro]
By the Sea of Tiberias
He revealed himself again
Nathanael from Cana
Witness to the risen Lord
